name: Stargazing VR
summary:
Stargazing VR lets you look up and discover stars and constellations, much as you would when observing the real night sky. It combines the joy of stargazing with convenient features made possible by VR.

Choose your observation location and date to explore the sky from different places and seasons. Advance time to watch the stars move, or observe the sky as it changes through daytime, twilight and night.
